headline: Equinix (EQIX) Appoints Chris Audie And Bruce Owen To Key Leadership Roles
summary: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) has updated its executive team with two senior appointments. Chris Audie has been named Chief Product Officer. Bruce Owen has been appointed Executive Vice President, Global Markets. The company expects these leadership moves to support product development and expansion across global markets. headline: Will Equinix's (EQIX) New AI-Focused Product Chief and Global Markets EVP Reshape Its Narrative?
summary: Equinix, Inc. recently appointed Chris Audie as Chief Product Officer and promoted 16-year company veteran Bruce Owen to Executive Vice President, Global Markets, reshaping its senior leadership around products, interconnection, and regional operations worldwide. The combination of Audie’s AI and cloud platform background with Owen’s deep internal experience suggests a tighter link between product innovation and global go-to-market execution across Equinix’s data center footprint.
